info.title: LankaLens FastAPI Backend
info.description:
**LankaLens API Platform**: Precision Cartography & Intelligent Sustainable Tourism API for Sri Lanka.

Provides REST endpoints for exploring destinations, building dynamic multi-day itineraries, interacting with AI assistants, tracking real-time site crowd density, and reporting eco hazards.

get.description: Retrieve destinations with search filter support by category, district, province, verification state, publication status, cost, rating, and search query.
